notes: Making avatars with a themed catalog is Roblox's Dress Up subgenre, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the answers rule out contests, judging and rounds, which removes the audience-and-judging half of the preset's stage-runway. Took space-bounded from the wider catalogue instead — outside this genre's typical list, and it routes plain P0 — because each theme is one clearly bounded single-level area the whole activity happens inside; rejected settlement-static and wilderness-open since a fairy garden or beach set is neither a town nor an open natural biome. Decided without a user: the whole-place theme swap is three alternate skins of that one bounded space with Fairy Garden built first, not three co-existing zones, so this stays a single-map P0 build and the other two themes are later builds of the same shape rather than P4. Kept the preset's vignette-photo for themed backdrops and social-hub as the free-form avatar-making floor.
